title: Sum of digits
prompt: Write sumDigits(n) recursively. It takes a non-negative integer n and returns the sum of its digits. Example: sumDigits(123) returns 6. Do not use loops or convert to a string.
commonBug: No base case, so the function never stops when n becomes 0 (infinite recursion or NaN).

title: Binary search
prompt: Write binarySearch(arr, target) for a sorted array of numbers. Return the index of target, or -1 if it is not present. Use binary search, not a linear scan.
commonBug: Off-by-one in the loop condition or bounds (for example while (lo < hi) or hi = arr.length), so the last element is missed.

title: Valid palindrome
prompt: Write isPalindrome(s). Return true if s reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring upper/lower case and ignoring every character that is not a letter or digit. An empty string is a palindrome.

tests.input: isPalindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama')

commonBug: Does not handle spaces, punctuation or upper/lower case, or fails on the empty string.

title: Maximum depth of a binary tree
prompt: Write maxDepth(root) for a binary tree. Each node is an object { val, left, right } where left and right are nodes or null. Return the number of nodes on the longest path from the root down to a leaf. An empty tree (null) has depth 0.
commonBug: Missing the null base case (crashes on null), or adds the two subtree depths instead of taking the maximum.

title: Can reach with DFS
prompt: Write canReach(graph, start, target) using DFS. graph is an adjacency list object like {0:[1,2],1:[3],2:[],3:[]}. Return true if target can be reached from start by following edges. The graph may contain cycles.
commonBug: No visited set, so DFS loops forever on a cycle.
